name: Strength Sap
notes: Applied to Deadwood (buff), represents 40% of target Strength stolen. 7s duration → ceil(7/5) = 2 turns. In engine: at apply time, calculate 40% of target Str and store as charges (bonus HP and damage for 2 turns). Extension field strength_steal_pct used for engine formula. This means Willowmaker against a high-Str enemy greatly empowers Deadwood.
